Rumors have long pointed to Apple preparing an all-glass new iPhone design for the 20th anniversary of the iPhone next year. But an analyst at Jefferies believes that device is no longer moving forward.

Wall Street Analyst Says iPhone 20th Anniversary Bold Redesign Has Been Cancelled

Wall Street investment bank Jefferies downgraded Apple stock to "Underperform" today, with analyst Edison Lee (李) noting that the potential cancellation of the 20th anniversary iPhone redesign is one of the main reasons.

The key to this downgrade lies in the suspected cancellation of Apple's all-glass iPhone. Although the project was reported to be in development as early as 2025, with rumors suggesting a launch as soon as 2027, Apple has never commented on the speculation. However, Apple quietly filed a patent application for a "six-sided glass enclosure" back in 2019. Jefferies had previously believed that launching an all-glass iPhone was possible, but Lee thinks development work has stalled. According to the analyst, supply chain checks show the project was cancelled due to excessively low yield rates. Lee considers this decision "a major setback in driving higher-priced iPhone launches amid surging memory prices." If the device were to launch in September 2027 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, he estimates the blended retail price would reach US$2,060, higher than the average selling price of any model in history. Lee wrote: "More importantly, we believe the original plan was to extend the all-glass design to future iPhone Pro and Pro Max models, further raising their average selling prices and profits." He believes that amid rising memory prices, this move would have been a key defensive strategy.

Lee also pointed to Apple's AI strategy and rising component costs for the iPhone 19 Pro as reasons for the further downgrade of the company's stock.

From Lee's report, it is unclear whether the analyst believes the entire redesign has been shelved, or only certain elements of it have been cancelled.

Top comment posted by Currentinterest

These analysts have been wrong many times in their predictions about Apple's future plans. Even the term "all-glass" may never have accurately reflected what Apple truly wanted to do. The 20th anniversary phone will be innovative, and there will be market demand for it, regardless of the final design.

For example, rumors have long suggested that Apple will not be able to completely remove the Dynamic Island cutout next year. As a result, an "all-glass" display is simply impossible. However, the rumored four-curved-edge design might still launch.

In any case, if the Apple iPhone 20th anniversary design really has been cancelled, we should get confirmation from other credible sources very soon.

What are your thoughts on this report about the iPhone 20th anniversary design? Let us know in the comments.
